task.title: Manage Credentials
task.shortdesc: Review, update, or remove the credentials the Git Client has stored for your Git servers.

context.p: The Git Client stores one credential set per server. You can see what is stored, remove individual entries, or clear everything.

step.cmd: Open the Git Client preferences page, then select the Credentials page.

info.p: The Credentials page lists every stored HTTP or token credential with its Host, Type (personal access token or basic authentication), and Username.

step.cmd: Select one or more entries, then select Remove.

info.p: Changes are applied only when you select OK or Apply, so you can cancel safely.

result.p: The next time an operation needs credentials for a removed server, the Git Client prompts you again. When you re-authenticate, the login dialog box pre-selects the stored authentication type and fills in the username for basic authentication.
result.note:
To remove several servers at once, select their rows on the Credentials page and select Remove. To clear a stored SSH passphrase, use the Clear button on the
preferences page.
